```{r Dependencies, include=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
	# Dependencies and libraries
	  .libPaths( c( './', .libPaths() ) )

		dep.l <- c('this.path', 'parallel', 'BSgenome', params$genome, 'magrittr', 'ggplot2', 'RColorBrewer', 'readr', 'dplyr', 'plyr')
		for (i in dep.l) {if(!suppressMessages(require(i, character.only = TRUE))) stop(paste0("Package not found: ", i))}
		GENOME <- get(params$genome)
		source('PPPPPP/smf_utils.R')

	# Data loading
		toLoad <- list.files(pattern=paste0(params$filterTag, '.bed.gz$'))
		readLength <-  read_tsv(toLoad, show_col_types = F)
		readLength$context <- params$context

	# plot output
		outPlot=paste('ReadStat', params$expName, params$filterTag, params$context, 'plots/', sep='_')
		if(!dir.exists(outPlot)){dir.create(path=outPlot)}

```

#Mapped read length distribution
```{r Distribution, warning=FALSE}
	n50Val <- sum(readLength$read_length)*.5
	N50data <- readLength %>%
		select(readID, read_length) %>%
		arrange(desc(read_length))
	N50 <- 0
	for (i in 1:nrow(N50data)) {
		N50 <- N50 + N50data$read_length[i]
		if(N50 > n50Val) {
				N50 = N50data$read_length[i]
				names(N50) <- N50data$readID[i]
			break
		}
	}
	rm(N50data, n50Val)
	readLenghtMed <- median(readLength$read_length)
	xLim <-  round_any(quantile(readLength$read_length, probs=.999, na.rm=T), 10000, f = ceiling)

	p <- ggplot(data=readLength[readLength$context == unique(readLength$context)[1],], aes(x=read_length)) +
	geom_vline(xintercept = c(N50,readLenghtMed), color = c("orchid3","grey"), linewidth=0.5) +
	geom_histogram(aes(y=after_stat(count)), binwidth=500, lwd=0.5, colour="white", fill="lightblue") +
	annotate("text", x = c(N50,readLenghtMed), y = Inf,
		label = c(paste0("N50:\n", prettyNum(N50)),paste0("Median:\n", prettyNum(readLenghtMed))),
		color = c("orchid3","grey"), vjust=1, hjust=-0.5, size=2) +
	scale_x_continuous(limits = c(1, xLim)) +
	theme_classic()
	ggsave(filename=paste0(outPlot,'read_distribution_noFilter.pdf'), plot=p, width=8, height= 6)
	p
```

#Get coverage over genome tiles
```{r Coverage, warning=FALSE}
	tiles <- keepStandardChromosomes(GRanges(seqinfo(GENOME)), pruning.mode ='coarse')

	GrReads <- GRanges(readLength)[,0]
	GrReads <- GrReads[seqnames(GrReads) %in% seqnames(tiles)]
	seqlevels(GrReads) <- seqlevels(tiles)
	seqinfo(GrReads) <- seqinfo(tiles)
	GrReads <- sort(trim(GrReads))

	chunks <- seq(1, 50000, 500)
	chunks <- c(50, chunks[-1]-1, 50000)
	chunks_tiles <- mclapply(chunks, function(i){
		return(tileGenome(seqlengths(GENOME)[as.character(seqnames(tiles))], tilewidth=i, cut.last.tile.in.chrom=TRUE))
	}, mc.cores = params$threads)
	names(chunks_tiles) <- paste0('tile_', chunks)

	data <- do.call(bind_rows, mclapply(chunks, function(i){
		counts <- countOverlaps(chunks_tiles[[paste0('tile_', i)]], GrReads, ignore.strand=TRUE, minoverlap =  i)
		return(tibble(chunk=i, Medians=median(counts, na.rm = TRUE)))
	}, mc.cores = params$threads))

	p <- ggplot(data, aes(x=chunk, y=Medians)) +
		geom_col(color='white', fill='lightblue') +
		labs(title="Medians of mapped read coverage over the genome tile length", y = "Read count", x='tile length') +
		scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(1, seq(5000, 50000, 5000))) +
		theme_classic()

	if(params$genome == 'BSgenome.Dmelanogaster.UCSC.dm6'){
		p <- p + geom_vline(xintercept = c(3820, 7350, 9740), color=c('maroon3', 'green3', 'red3')) +
		annotate("text", x=c(3820,7350,9740), y=Inf, label = c('E-E','E-P','P-P'), angle=90, size=4, color=c('maroon3', 'green3', 'red3'), vjust=-1, hjust=1)
	}
	ggsave(filename=paste0(outPlot,'Coverage_over_genome_tiles.pdf'), plot=p, width=8, height= 6)
	p
```

```{r Coverage Violin, warning=FALSE}
	data <- do.call(bind_rows, mclapply(c(50, 1000, 5000, 10000, 15000, 20000, 25000, 30000), function(i){
	  counts <- countOverlaps(chunks_tiles[[paste0('tile_', i)]], GrReads, ignore.strand=TRUE, minoverlap =  i)
	  return(tibble(chunk=as.factor(rep(i, length(counts))), read_count=counts))
	}, mc.cores = params$threads))

	data$chunk <- gsub('^500$', '0.5kb', data$chunk) %>% gsub('500$', '.5kb', .) %>%
		gsub('000$', 'kb', .) %>%  gsub('^1$', '1bp', .) %>%
		factor(., levels=unique(.))

	p <- ggplot(data, aes(x=chunk, y=read_count, fill=chunk)) +
		geom_violin(trim=TRUE, bw=1, show.legend=F) +
		geom_boxplot(width=0.1, fill="white", outlier.shape = NA) +
		labs(title='Mapped read coverage over long distance bin', x="tile length", y = "Read count") +
		scale_fill_brewer(palette="RdBu") +
		theme_bw()
	ggsave(filename=paste0(outPlot,'Coverage_over_genome_tiles_violin.pdf'), plot=p, width=8 , height=6)
	p
```

# Methylation distribution per read
```{r Single Molecule, warning=FALSE}
	p1 <- ggplot(readLength, aes(x=context, y=read_methylation_rate, fill=context)) +
	  geom_violin(trim=FALSE, bw=0.01, show.legend=F) + #geom_split_violin
		geom_boxplot(width=0.1, fill="white", outlier.shape = NA) +
		labs(title='Distribution of methylation per read', x="context", y = "Methylation rate") +
		scale_fill_brewer(palette="RdBu") +
		facet_wrap(~context) +
		theme_bw()
	ggsave(filename=paste0(outPlot,'perRead_meth_distribution.pdf'), plot=p1, width=8 , height=6)
	p1

	p2 <- ggplot(readLength, aes(x=context, y=called_Cs, fill=context)) +
	  geom_violin(trim=TRUE, show.legend=F) +
		geom_boxplot(width=0.1, fill="white", outlier.shape = NA) +
		labs(title='Distribution of aggregate Cs per read', x="context", y = "Cytosine count") +
		scale_fill_brewer(palette="RdBu") +
		theme_bw()
	ggsave(filename=paste0(outPlot,'perRead_meth_cytosinecount.pdf'), plot=p2, width=8 , height=6)
	p2

	p3 <- ggplot(readLength[readLength$context == unique(readLength$context)[1],], aes(x=read_length, y=called_Cs)) +
	  geom_hex(bins = 75) +
	  geom_smooth(method=lm, formula='y ~ x', se=FALSE, fullrange=TRUE) +
	  scale_fill_continuous(type = "viridis") +
		labs(title='aggregate Cs in function of read length', x="read length", y = "Cytosine count") +
		theme_bw()
	ggsave(filename=paste0(outPlot,'perRead_meth_cytosinecount_readlength.pdf'), plot=p3, width=8, height=6)
	p3

	p4 <- ggplot(readLength, aes(x=read_length, y=read_methylation_rate)) +
	  geom_hex(bins = 75) +
	  scale_fill_continuous(type = "viridis") +
		labs(title='Read methyaltion rate in function of read length', x="read length", y = "read methylation rate") +
		facet_wrap(~context) +
		theme_bw()
	ggsave(filename=paste0(outPlot,'perRead_meth_rate_readlength.pdf'), plot=p4, width=8 , height=6)
	p4
```
